lane_matrix.note: percent of total weight, source lane = row; FF by node-level champion order; diagonal = intra-lane

flow_hierarchy_test.note: rho of flow ordinal (aff<intr<eff) vs champion rank; label permutation null; p is a <= bound at the 1/perms floor

nt_direction._note: top_nt is a PREDICTION (Eckstein et al. 2024) joined from the annotation table, not ground truth

nt_stats.note: absolute synapse weight by SOURCE neuron's predicted transmitter (Eckstein et al. 2024); ff by the node-level champion order

sink_audit.note: cells with >50% zero-out-weight members are hatched grey. In sensory/optic lanes these are truncated fragments the optimizer necessarily places late (an artifact, not biology); for motor/endocrine they are genuine terminals whose outputs leave the brain and hence the graph

lane_order_check.defense: median is used because several lanes are heavily skewed (optic (other): 205 nodes with a long late tail; central (other): a 22k grab-bag) — the mean follows the tail, the median follows the mass

spectral.weights: log1p of undirected collapsed synapse counts
spectral.operator: tau-regularized random-walk (D+tau I)^-1 (W + tau/n J), deflated power iteration; within-lane use is ORDINAL (rank)

provenance.materialization_note: The MFAS-challenge graph and the annotation table use the same FlyWire root-ID space; the 99.99% join (13 unmatched of 136,648, listed above) is the evidence — no ID translation was applied.
